newsitem.title: UK: Wardle Storeys sees strong H2.
newsitem.headline: Wardle Storeys sees strong H2.

text.p: Wardle Storeys Plc said on Monday it expected a strong performance in the second half, after flat profits in the first six months of its financial year.
The maker of plastics sheets as well as airborne and inflatable systems said the first-half profits of 4.8 million stg were as expected.
Results did not rise because several large contracts in the airborne division will fall in the second half of the year, chief executive Brian Taylor told Reuters.
He said Wardle was in the advanced stages of concluding a couple of acquisitions, adding the company had a total 20 million stg in cash available for purchases.
"But I don't think we'll need all that for acquisitions," he said.
Wardle seeks deals in the inflatable systems and airborne sytems divisions where it wants to expand its products range and geographical spread.
